details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. The retrieved statistics identify 2025 as the latest listed year and give 8,174 submissions, with 1,811 accepted to the Main Track and 1,418 accepted to Findings.
2. Combining the accepted counts gives 3,229 accepted papers. Dividing 3,229 by 8,174 submissions gives approximately 39.50% when rounded to two decimal places.
3. Thus the citation contains the information needed to derive the gold target answer.
